title: Xavier Clark and Mathaius Young teamed up for the new single "NUMB."
htmlContent:
Talented music artists Xavier Clark and Mathaius Young teamed up for the new single called "NUMB" from the new album "WHEN THE SMOKE CLEARS," which showcases a craft and smooth production that can't be compared. The latest single, "NUMB," is a modern, smooth, and perfectly catchy song. Song you should add to your playlist.

Stream Xavier Clark and Mathaius Young's "NUMB" on Spotify.
